_readme: Performance contests (2026-10-04) — one social duel (the Courtly engine), many styles. Each profile: label, fuel [full pool, half pool] for starting Influence, the four moves (persuade/inspire/expose/intimidate keep their mechanics; label + OP pool are the style's), crowd (who is judging; the Suspicion track), crowdTrack (its chat name), foul (the move that ends it ugly) + foulText. Endings route via api.raid.performance: triumph (the party wins clean), grace (loss, stalemate, mutual ruin), ugly (anyone fouls). Add a style here; no code needed.

dance.label: The Floor

persuade.label: Find the Pocket
persuade.hint: Lock into the beat and do not leave it.

inspire.label: Showstopper
inspire.hint: A figure the crowd will talk about for a week.

expose.label: Call-Out
expose.hint: Answer their figure with a better one, at them. The crowd gets loud.

intimidate.label: Draw Steel
intimidate.hint: FOUL. Nobody draws steel on the floor. Ends it ugly.

dance.foulText: drew steel on the floor. The music stops. Everyone will remember who escalated.

skate.label: The Skate-Off

persuade.label: Land the Line
persuade.hint: Clean, committed, the way the run was drawn.

inspire.label: Go Big
inspire.hint: Something the rail will film. Eating pavement interestingly counts.

expose.label: Call Their Bail
expose.hint: Point out the sketchy landing, loudly. The rail takes sides.

intimidate.label: Bust Them (Mall Cop)
intimidate.hint: FOUL. Shut the session down like a mall cop. Ends it ugly, forever.

skate.foulText: went full mall cop and shut the session down. The wheels stop. The rail goes quiet in the worst way.
